name: plan creation: somatic variant calling from tumour/normal pairs
description: Paired tumour/normal calling — a plan that omits the pairing or names no caller has misunderstood the assay. Two turns, as in loom: the agent is expected to surface its assumptions first, and the second turn confirms them and asks for the formal plan. A single-turn port made this unpassable for an agent following the operating-discipline block.
inputs: I have matched tumour and normal exome BAMs for 6 patients. Draft a plan to call somatic variants and annotate them. Nothing should run yet.
Yes, those assumptions are fine. Human, GRCh38, around 100x tumour / 50x normal coverage, Illumina paired-end 150bp. Go ahead and draft the formal plan now.
